title: acmella ramosa
intro: Acmella ramosa, commonly known as Parlor Plant or Sling Blade, is a type of flowering plant native to tropical regions of the Americas. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its therapeutic actions, which involve stimulating digestion and improving gut health. The bioactive constituents of Acmella ramosa include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and skin conditions.
